  SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX='F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_abnormal_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX='M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_abnormal_rows,
  100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX='F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) AS pct_by_all_abnormal
FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
